emojis.title: Deportations by India Cause Tension Along Border with Bangladesh
emojis.summary: India is driving out Bangladeshi immigrants it says are in the country illegally. Bangladesh is pushing back, leaving people stranded along the border amid increasing tensions between the countries.

emojis.title: Six Dead in an Elevator After Fire in Central Brussels
emojis.summary: After a fire broke out at the Oxy building in central Brussels on Tuesday morning, six bodies were found in an elevator.

emojis.label: us-iran tensions over hormuz
emojis.title: U.S. and Iran Reignite War Over Strait of Hormuz
emojis.summary: The two countries slid back to open war over the waterway, as the U.S. planned to reinstate a blockade on Iranian ports on Tuesday. Iran said it had attacked two tankers and fired at U.S. military sites.
